title: Venues and networks get their own operator email wording
detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1141. The day 0, 1, 3 and 7 operator emails now have a venue variant (a Space whose kind is venue) and a network variant (a Space with member Spaces). The network check is one head count per send, read only for days 1, 3 and 7 inside the lifecycle cron. Day 0 is sent at creation, when a Space cannot yet have chapters, so it reads the kind alone.
